svg.title: MedMe user flow — Patient, Professional, Clinic
svg.desc: Three parallel columns showing the journey of each role through the on-demand home healthcare service, connected at three token exchange moments.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does MedMe filter by service type before showing location?')
sendPrompt('How does payment escrow work in MedMe?')
sendPrompt('How does credential matching work for the professional?')
sendPrompt('How does the clinic filter professionals by service type?')
sendPrompt('Why does the professional need Token 1 to collect equipment?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 1 track for the clinic?')
sendPrompt('How does Token 2 protect both patient and professional?')
sendPrompt('How does Token 2 protect both patient and professional?')
sendPrompt('How does Token 3 trigger payment release?')
sendPrompt('What triggers the payment to the clinic after service?')
sendPrompt('What does the clinic see after service completion?')
